verdict.summary: Every service provider is named (Invesco, BNY Mellon, NAV Fund Services, Superstate Services as transfer agent), so the A/H/T, register and NAV outline can be said in v3. But the Solana mint is Token-2022 with a permanent delegate and default account state, so it cannot be read; ownership-interest hides a registered trust-series interest; the record that prevails and the eligibility rules are proposals; and the ranking of liquidity providers ahead of shareholders can be said only in text. Superstate publishes almost everything; the fund, custodian and valuation agent say nothing in their own name.
